title: 第550章 邪物效果验收第549章 邪教军火库
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条第一卷：冒险者第550章邪物效果验收（..la）“三年前。”
龙喉站在猩红光芒中，一件接着一件向外掏东西。
“升任到佩德罗里的混血后裔，差不多就是目前这个规模了。”
“直到今年，其中一个孩子，终于坐上了管理这些缴获‘邪物’的主管位置。”
日晷暗面行省长官脸上的血色，彻底消失了。
那名主管甚至不需要带走所有邪物。
只需要挑出最适合今天这个战场的东西。
“你们费了大劲收来的东西。”
龙喉笑得越来越肆意。
“由我来替你们检验效果啦！”
一枚礼花筒被扔上半空。
外壳画着金色太阳，下面还写着一句庆祝破晓的颂词。
可礼花筒升到半空后，炸开的却不是金色花火。
“轰！”
刺目的白光淹没视野。
紧接着，数百枚燃烧的黑红火球向下坠落。
它们没有飞向天空，而是直扑各层台地的人群与建筑。
维克多根本不用猜。
会把爆炸称为“净化”的邪教，这个世界上找不出几家。
【新纪元方舟会】

“净化世界！”
“迎接新生！”
礼花爆炸后，里面竟然还传出了整齐的口号声。
一边制造爆炸，一边自带庆祝音效。
很符合他们的风格。
几名法师不得不放弃攻击祖灵，转而撑起元素屏障，挡住从空中落下的火球。
龙喉又取出一个水晶瓶。
瓶中封着一颗浑浊眼球。
眼球足有成年人拳头大小，泡在灰色液体中，瞳孔却一直随着周围人群转动。
龙喉拔开瓶塞。
那颗眼球自动飘了起来。
浑浊瞳孔猛地扩大。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book lovers: Please do not enchant basic skills with strange entries Volume 1: Adventurer Chapter 550 Acceptance of Evil Object Effects (..la) "Three years ago."
Dragon Throat stood in the scarlet light, taking out things one after another.
"The number of mixed-race descendants who have been promoted to Pedroli is almost the same as it is now."
"It wasn't until this year that one of the children finally took a supervisory position in managing these seized 'evil objects'."
The color on the face of the provincial governor on the dark side of the sundial completely disappeared.
That supervisor doesn't even need to take away all the evil stuff.
Just pick out what's best for today's battlefield.
"What you went through so much trouble to collect."
Dragon Throat laughed more and more wantonly.
"Let me test the effect for you!"
A fireworks tube was thrown into the air.
The outer shell is painted with a golden sun, and underneath is a eulogy celebrating the dawn.
But after the fireworks tube rose into the air, what exploded was not golden fireworks.
"Boom!"
Blinding white light flooded the field of vision.
Immediately afterwards, hundreds of burning black and red fireballs fell downwards.
They did not fly into the sky, but directly attacked the crowds and buildings on the terraces.
Victor didn't have to guess at all.
There are not many cults in the world that would call explosions "purification."
【New Era Ark Club】
"Purify the world!"
"Welcome the new student!"
After the fireworks exploded, neat slogans came from inside.
While creating explosions, it also comes with celebratory sound effects.
It fits their style very well.
Several mages had to give up attacking the ancestral spirits and instead propped up elemental barriers to block the fireballs falling from the sky.
Dragon Throat took out another crystal bottle.
There is a cloudy eyeball sealed in the bottle.
The eyeballs are the size of an adult's fist, soaked in gray liquid, but the pupils keep rotating with the surrounding people.
Dragon Throat uncorked the bottle.
The eyeball floated up automatically.
The cloudy pupils suddenly expanded.
